pairs: præparatus mons domus Domini in vertice montium,
the mountain of the house of the Lord will be prepared at the summit of the mountains,
and it will be exalted above the hills,
et fluent ad eum omnes gentes,
and all the nations shall flow to it.
and ascend to the mountain of the Lord,
and to the house of the God of Jacob.
And he will teach us his ways,
and we will walk in his paths.”
For the law will go forth from Zion,
and the Word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
And he will judge the nations,
and he will rebuke many peoples.
et conflabunt gladios suos in vomeres,
And they shall forge their swords into plowshares,
Non levabit gens contra gentem gladium,
Nation will not lift up sword against nation,
neither will they continue to train for battle.
and walk in the light of the Lord.
For you have cast aside your people,
because they have been filled up, as in past times,
and because they have had soothsayers as the Philistines have,
and because they have joined themselves to foreign servants.
Repleta est terra argento et auro,
Their land has been filled with silver and gold.
et non est finis thesaurorum ejus.
And there is no end to their storehouses.
Et repleta est terra ejus equis,
And their land has been filled with horses.
And their four-horse chariots are innumerable.
Et repleta est terra ejus idolis;
And their land has been filled with idols.
They have adored the work of their hands,
which their own fingers have made.
And man has bowed himself down,
and so man has become debased.
Therefore, you should not forgive them.
et abscondere in fossa humo a facie timoris Domini,
and hide in a ditch in the soil, from the presence of the fear of the Lord,
and from the glory of his majesty.
The lofty eyes of man have been humbled,
and the haughtiness of men will be bowed down.
exaltabitur autem Dominus solus in die illa.
Then the Lord alone shall be exalted, in that day.
Quia dies Domini exercituum super omnem superbum,
For the day of the Lord of hosts will prevail over all the proud
and each one shall be humbled,
et super omnes cedros Libani sublimes et erectas,
and over all the straight and tall cedars of Lebanon,
and over all the oaks of Bashan;
and over all the lofty mountains,
and over all the elevated hills;
and over all the ships of Tarshish,
et super omne quod visu pulchrum est,
and over all the beauty that may be seen.
And the loftiness of men will be bowed down,
and the haughtiness of men will be brought low.
et elevabitur Dominus solus in die illa;
And the Lord alone shall be exalted, in that day.
And idols will be thoroughly crushed.
And they will go into the caves of the rocks,
and into the caverns of the earth,
from the presence of the dread of the Lord,
and from the glory of his majesty,
when he will have risen up to strike the earth.
In die illa projiciet homo idola argenti sui,
man shall cast aside his idols of silver and his images of gold,
which he had made for himself,
as if to reverence the moles and the bats.
And so he will go into the clefts of the rocks,
and into the caverns of stone,
from the presence of the dread of the Lord,
and from the glory of his majesty,
when he will have risen up to strike the earth.
cujus spiritus in naribus ejus est,
whose breath is in his nostrils,
for he considers himself to be exalted.
